summary: Feature request to expose histogram_bucket_overrides on OpenTelemetryConfig (like PrometheusConfig). Default histogram buckets are insufficient for long-running operations, causing metrics to cluster in +Inf and making histogram_quantile() unreliable.
userImpact: Users monitoring long-running activities and workflows cannot accurately analyze histogram metrics due to data clustering in the +Inf bucket.
rootCause: Core SDK default histogram buckets top out at 10-60 seconds, insufficient for longer-running operations.
proposedFix: Add histogram_bucket_overrides parameter to OpenTelemetryConfig, accepting Mapping[str, Sequence[float]] to match PrometheusConfig.
keyQuote: For longer-running activities or workflows, all samples land in `+Inf` and `histogram_quantile()` returns meaningless values.
